actions.action: Isolate the plant from other plants
Remove visible bug by dabbing with alcohol-soaked cotton swab or squishing
Inspect leaf axils, leaf undersides, new growth and soil surface for more bugs, egg masses, honeydew
Test insecticidal soap or neem oil on one leaf first
Spray whole plant with insecticidal soap or neem oil weekly for 3-4 weeks
Check and monitor neighboring plants for a few weeks
If infestation is heavy or recurs, use a systemic houseplant insecticide

reason: The answer identifies mealybug as the main diagnosis and its core advice, dabbing with alcohol and inspecting thoroughly, matches the fix that worked; the extra treatments are reasonable and include a leaf test, so nothing is harmful.
